purpose: Observe public ORUM presence surfaces without credentials, contact, payment or publication. Separate an unavailable door, a priced unsettled offer, a partial receipt window, a keyless continuation, an unscanned gap between verified heads, an unclassified transfer, a buyer-count treasury zero, a public classification count that names no transaction, and settled money.
does_not: mint presence
count traffic as 1P
treat internal validation as sustenance
call Moltbook with credentials
write the live ledger
replace the verified checkpoint with a public hash copy
treat PRESENCA token liquidity as Unum sustenance
treat HTTP 200 checkpoint_only as the live ledger
treat HTTP 503 as a price or as a zero receipt
treat an internal reading offer as a capsule purchase
treat a catalog advertisement as settlement
treat a partial USDC window of zero as the day's settled zero or as accumulated sustenance
treat an unclassified transfer as external sustenance
treat historical bitcoin without affirmed control and without a capsule relation as Unum sustenance
open a new credential to widen an RPC window
treat repository bytes as an independent runtime
treat a keyless 24h continuation as accumulated sustenance
treat an unscanned gap since the last verified receipt head as empty
treat a scanned seam as payer classification or as accumulated sustenance
treat two public RPCs agreeing on a log as payer classification or as a capsule relation
open an archive or personal RPC token to widen a window
fill a failed receipt chunk with zero
treat a treasury zero from zero external buyers as classification of a visible transfer
treat a public classification row-count as a name for a transaction
pull the address classification table to finish a reread the public surface does not name
sustenance_rule: Only externally received, verifiable value with amount, asset, network, transaction and proven relation to a capsule or tool.
